tei:div.tei:p: ༈ kun mkhyen chos rje klong chen pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/

kun mkhyen chos rje klong rams pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdus ni/ de la gang du sku bltams pa'i yul ni/ g.yo ru grwa'i stod grong du/ yab gu ru'i dngos slob ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi gdung rus zam ma chad pa'i mi rabs nyer drug par/ sngags 'chang bstan pa srung dang*/ yum 'brom bza' bsod nams rgyan gnyis kyi sras su/ dus rab byung lnga pa'i nang gi sa pho sprel lo'i dbo zla'i tshes brgyad rgyal 'dzoms la/ yum gyi rmis ltas ngo mtshar ba dang bcas mtshan dpe'i pad+mo gsar du 'bus/ sku bltams ma thag nam gru re ma ti bud med nag mo'i gzugs kyis phyag tu blangs te/ sprul pa'i sku 'di ngas srung ba yin zer nas slar yum la gtad de mi snang bar song ba bzhin/ nam dgos dgos su gzugs tha dad pa'i sgo nas bsrung ba dang zhabs tog tshul bzhin sgrub pa'o/ / sku chung ngu nas byams snying rje dang blo gros kyi mthu che bas dgung lo lnga tsam nas 'bri klog tshegs med du mkhyen/ bdun nas bzung yab la bka' brgyad bde 'dus sogs sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig gi dbang lung man ngag phyag bzhes tshun dang*/ sman rtsis sogs thun mong gi rig gnas 'ga' yang byang chub par mdzad/ dgung lo dgu skor nas/ nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa gnyis brgya rtsa klog pas thugs su chud/ bcu gnyis la bsam yas su mkhan po bsam 'grub rin chen dang*/ slob dpon kun dga' 'od zer las rab tu byung*/ mtshan tshul khrims blo gros su gsol te/ 'dul ba la bslabs pas/ bshad gsar dang de'i gral skor yang mdzad/ dgung lo bcu drug nas slob dpon bkra rin las lam 'bras gnyis sogs dang*/ slob dpon dbang yes las dus 'khor sogs dang*/ za lung rin po che las zhang tshal pa'i chos skor sogs dang*/ khyad par du dgung lo bcu dgu'i dus gsang phur byon nas btsan dgon pa dang*/ bla brang pa chos dpal rgyal mtshan/ chos grags gnyis par grags pa gzhon nu rin chen gsum gtso bor brten te phar tshad kyi gzhung 'grel rnams kyi tshig don la lo drug gi bar du sgro

'dogs legs par bcad/ gzhan yang skad gnyis smra ba blo gros brtan pa dang*/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ shug gseb rin po che/ dan phag pa gzhon nu don grub/ gnyos mthing ma pa sangs rgyas grags 'od/ sa skya'i bla ma bdag nyid chen po/ bla ma khro phu pa sogs mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen bcu phrag gnyis lhag tshul bzhin brten te/ dus der bod yul du grags pa'i mdo rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa phal cher gsan cing*/ bzo gso rtsis snyan sogs thun mong shes bya'i tshul la 'ang mkhas par bslabs/ gsan pa tsam du ma bzhag par de dag gi skabs ci rigs par/ mi g.yo ba dang*/ dbyangs can ma shes rab gsal byed sogs kyi sgrub pa mdzad pas lha so so'i zhal gzigs dang*/ khyad par dbyangs can ma'i phyag mthil du bzhag nas gling bzhi ri rab bcas zhag du mar gzigs shing*/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi pad+mo lhug par grol te blo gros phyogs med kyi 'dab ma rgyas pas/ gsang phu sogs rig gra rnams su bsam yas lung mang ba zhes grags/ gsang phur bzhugs pa'i skabs shig khams btsun rnams kyis yang yang gtses par brten rgyam phur phebs pa dang*/ nas rkyal pa gang gis mtshams rgyag byas te/ sgrub pa smar bar mdzad pas/ zla ba lnga tsam na 'phags ma yin snyam pa'i bud med gos bzang gser g.yus brgyan pa zhig gi zhal gzigs shing*/ thugs rjes 'dzin par gsol ba btabs pas/ rtag tu rjes su 'dzin pa'i zhal bzhes gnang*/ dbu rgyan phud de nyid la gsol bas/ zla ba gcig gi yun la bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin phyam brdal/ khyad par du rig 'dzin chen po dang mjal ba'i lung bstan thob/ mtshams las thon te yum gyi don du kun rig gi cho ga brgya rtsa brgyad mdzad/ de nas yar stod rgyam phur byon/ rig 'dzin chen po dpon slob rnams sbra dang phya ther bdun cu tsam mdzad nas bzhugs pa dang mjal/ khong gi zhal nas mdang lha yi bya yin zer ba ya mtshan pa zhig la bya bran stong gis bskor nas/

nga'i dpe cha khyer bzhin phyogs tha dad du 'phur ba rmis pas/ chos 'di'i brgyud 'dzin zhig 'ong bar 'dug gsungs nas dgyes tshor chen po mdzad/ de bzhin gzims lam du paṇa chen bi ma las kyang nga yis smon lam btabs pa'i skyes bu yin pas rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa skyong ba 'ong zhes lung bstan pa la/ sham po gangs rar dbang dang gdam pa mang po dang*/ khyad par du theg pa bla na med pa 'od gsal gsang ba snying po phyi nang gsang skor/ rgyud bcu bdun/ man ngag brgya dang bcu dgu las phran dang bcas pa/ ma gza' dam gsum legs ldan lcam dral sogs kyi sgrub skor las phran phyag bzhes dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang zhing*/ rgyal tshab chen por dbang bskur/ drang srong rā hu las rang rtags tham dmar rnam bcu dbang ldan rang ming gi ri mo yod pa dngos su phul zhing*/ ci bsgo ba'i bran du khas blangs/ de phyis kun gyi mthun snang du phrin las rno myur shin tu che/ de ltar snying thig chen mo'i dbang rgyud man ngag gtso bor gyur pa'i smin grol chos kyi bdud rtsi mtha' yas pa bzhes shing*/ bya bral kun spangs kho nas/ mchims phur lo bdun gyi bar dam bcas sgrub pa nyams bzhes snying por mdzad pas/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha du mas byin gyis brlabs shing*/ rig pa tshad phebs chen po'i sa la gshegs/ gzhan yang dge'u gong dang*/ dur khrod/ bya 'ug lha khang sogs su sgrub pa kho nar mdzad cing rtsa gsum lha yi zhal gzigs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab/ sgrub pa de dag gi tshe mthun rkyen dman pas dngul chu'i bcud len dang*/ grang dang kha ba'i dus su sgye mo zhig yod pa des gos gdan gnyis kyi go bcad de bzhugs pa sogs dka' spyad mdzad tshul la'ang sus kyang 'gran du med/ phyis zhig la dan phag tu byon nas rgyud gsang ba snying po gsan te mar lam res mo dgon du byon/ res mo ba dang gsung gleng mdzad par/

khong la mkha' 'gros brdas bskul bar dgongs te zhu nan mdzad pas mchims phur snying thig gsung pa'i zhal bzhes gnang*/ dgung lo nyer brgyad par mchims phu ra mo can du snying thig gsung pas me tog gi char babs pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang du byung*/ gzhan yang gangs ri thod dkar dang*/ shug gseb/ te sgro'i mtshon pa'i gnas rnams su rtse gcig pa'i sgrub pa dang*/ skal ldan rnams la zab chos 'doms pa sogs 'chad pa dang*/ dgos pa khyad par can gyi rtsom pa dang*/ zhwa'i lha khang gis mtshon pa'i rten gsum nyams pa rnams gso ba sogs rgyal bstan 'khor lo gsum gyi bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad/ gzhan gdul bar dka' ba'i phyogs glo mon dge sdig mi shes pa dang*/ mon bum thang sogs dam pa'i chos kyi sgra mi grags pa rnams su'ang*/ brtse ba chen pos dge bcu'i lam la bkod/ bstan srung rnams kyi phrin las dang bcas pas ri rgya/ klung rgya sogs thams cad bde 'jam yugs gcig tu mdzad/ tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsug /de bzhin du lho brag dang*/ yar 'brog /lha ldan/ g.yor po sogs gdan 'dren zhu nan che ba rnams su phebs te/ rang rang gi skal pa dang 'tshams pa'i dam pa'i chos kyis tshims par mdzad/ de skabs che bar grags pa'i khri dpon rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ tā si byang chub rgyal mtshan/ si tu shākya bzang po sogs bla chen dang dpon skya che 'dod kyis nga rgyal zhing*/ sngar sdang zhugs can rnams kyang zhabs la btud cing gdan 'dren sogs mang yang*/ thugs rgyud khengs pa'i dregs pa mi mnga'/ bla chen gyi lad mo mi mdzad/ mi chen gyi ngo bsrung mi gnang*/ de dag gi tshe dad rdzas ci byung ba'i sum gnyis tshes bcu sogs dus mchod la btang zhing*/ sum cha gcig 'phral dgos kyi 'tsho ba dang*/ bu slob gzigs skyong mdzad pa'i dam bca' brtan por gnang/ dad zas chud mi gson pa'i ched/ dus mchod kyi zan yang dar ba dang sing pos brdzi zhing*/

spyan lam du byung ba'i bza' btung mchod pa'i dmigs bsgoms byas pa la/ che btsun gal po che su byung yang 'di zos pas mi 'ju gsungs nas mi gnang*/ sku chas dang phyag rdzas tshun chad spang dag lan gsum du mdzad cing*/ 'gyed mdzad dus gral mtho ba rnams kyi skal pa chad dogs med gsungs nas/ gral gzhug nas yar 'gyed/ bkur bsti dge 'dun la dgos pa yin gsungs nas skye nag la mi gnang*/ chen por 'dod pa rnams la gdan mi 'ding*/ bkur bsti mi mdzad pa thugs kyi dam bca' yin/ 'byor ldan phyug po rnams kyis tshogs bsags dang 'bul ba ji tsam byas kyang yon bsngo mdzad pa las/ thugs la btags pa zhal nas mi 'don/ gdab lan dang gnang sbyin mi mdzad/ byas na tshong du 'gro bas kho'i dngos po chud zos su 'gro ba yin gsungs/ shākya thub pa la ras yug gser srang stong ri ba phul yang bsngo ba mdzad pa las gnang sbyin mdzad pa'i srol med/ tshogs bsags dang che 'don sogs yon bdag gis bya rgyu yin/ yon mchod go log tu song na nan tar mi bzang ba'i gtam rgyud dang*/ lung 'dren mang du mdzad/ sprang po sogs nyams chung zhig gis skyo nag zhig drangs na'ang zhim zhim ltar gsol nas/ mdo bsngo dang yon bshad rgyas pa re mdzad pa sogs mthun snang phyi yi rnam thar tsam la'ang dang ba 'dren pa'i mdzad spyod bsam gyis mi khyab/ de bzhin du zol med brtse ba chen pos phyi rabs bstan 'gro'i don du gnang ba'i phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid gnas gsum du dbyes pa'i chos tshan sum brgyar nye ba las/ gzhan dang mi gnyis pa'i nang rgyud yo ga gsum nas khyad par yang gsang bla na med pa'i skor tsho'i bar gyi gdams ngag dang man ngag rgyab chos sogs/ zab zab gnyen gnyen gang gis kyang mi 'gran pa da lta'i bar du bzhugs pa 'di ka lags/ tha ma'i mdzad pa tshogs pa la dbang khrid shin tu rgyas pa rgyab chos bcas gsungs nas/ rgyal sras bzod par zhal chems dri med 'od gnang ba'i skabs/

da ni mi sdod pad ma las 'brel rtsal/ /'chi med bde chen btsan sa 'dzin du 'gro/ /sogs gsungs par/ bzod pa spyan chab nyil bzhin rten 'brel ngan pa de 'dra mi gsung bar zhus pas/ rten 'brel ngan rgyu ci yod/ da lta dal ba'i dus byas pas/ da gzod brel ba'i dus su phan pa yin sogs dang*/ khyed rang gzhan don nus pa tshos/ skal ldan slob ma gang byung la rang 'dod kyi 'khris med par smin grol stsol/ man ngag ston/ dam chos nyams su len pa rnams kyis 'jig rten gyi bya ba don du mi gnyer bar khregs thod kyi don la mnyam par zhogs/ ma go bar byung na kho bos byas pa'i yang tig yid bzhin nor bu 'di dgos 'byung bsam 'phel dang 'dra ba yin pas lta rtog zhib mo gyis nas sgoms dang*/ 'khor ba zad sar bskyal nas myang 'das gdod ma'i sa la slebs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs legs par gdams nas dgung lo nga drug bzhes pa chu mo yos kyi lo rgyal zla'i tshes bco brgyad kyi dro khar mchims phu nags kyi dur khrod gsang chen me tog phug tu/ da ni sgyu lus gog po 'di 'dor ba yin pas khyed rnams ca co ma byed par mnyam par zhog la sdod ces gsungs nas/ ngo mtshar ba'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab par 'du mdzad de/ chos sku'i bzhugs stangs kyis gdod ma'i zad sar gshegs so/ /zhal slob kyang rgyal sras bzod pa/ glu mkhan bsod seng*/ mkhas grub khyab gdal lhun grub/ bde legs rgyal mtsho/ chos kyi grags pa/ slob dpon gzhon nu sangs rgyas/ slob dpon dpal mchog /bla ma o rgyan pa/ mkhan chen dge 'dun rgyal mtshan/ bla ma spos gong pa sogs mdor na dus der chos kyi tshogs pa re rera'ang chos 'chad nus pa'i bla ma slob dpon bzhi bcur slebs pa tsam gyis mtshon te shin tu mang ngo*// //zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas 'gro 'dul rdo rjes so// // PAGE sngon 'gro'i zhu tshig
